text:
Adam Fantilli has spent part of this season as the face of Columbus's frustrations, and after a loss to Toronto he called it "an embarrassing game for us." He's 22, the third overall pick from 2023, and the numbers say the frustration shouldn't land on him.

He plays 20:25 a night and has 66 shots and 8.2 expected goals in 22 games. Seven goals is a little light for those looks, and All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) puts him at the 93rd percentile among forwards for chances from the home plate in front of the net. The assists are the strange part: only four, and his point rate (1.47 per 60) sits well below his talent range. That usually rises. The concern is five on five, where Columbus takes 47% of the expected goals with him on, about two points worse than without him. He's physical too, 48 hits. Our range projects 43 to 64 points and 21 to 35 goals. The goals should keep coming; the setups have to.
